title: Instagram Protects Creators From Having Their Videos Stolen! 🎥
body: Instagram Protects Creators From Having Their Videos Stolen! 🎥

Instagram began rolling out its "Content Protection" tool on Tuesday, letting eligible creators discover and deal with unauthorized copies of their videos across Instagram and Facebook. After signing up, a creator gets a notification when Instagram detects a visual match with an original video, and can monitor the copy's performance, hide it, add an attribution link that directs viewers to the original, or waive the claim.

If someone reposts your video as their own, Instagram will now tell you — and you can hide it or claim it with a link that sends viewers back to your original video. Even better, the tool is also testing detection of AI-generated copies that steal your voice or original words even if the image is swapped for a generated one. New videos are protected automatically after sign-up, and older ones are selected manually.
Has one of your videos ever been stolen? 😤
